comment: Blocked recipe for the hero-defender arm of uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_acid. The hostile ochre jelly starts with its AT_ENGL AD_ACID attack. C mhitu.c:mattacku routes that attack to gulpmu unless getmattk rewrites it to AT_TUCH while mspec_used remains positive; the ordinary expulsion cooldown from mon.c:unstuck expires in mon.c:mcalcdistress -> monmove.c:mon_regen before the next attack. This recipe records the natural engulf route only and does not establish mhitm_ad_acid hero-defender coverage.
